gate.text: Only someone with access to the server can start setup. Enter the token printed by the installer, or generate a new one on the server with:
gate.tokenHelp: Valid for 1 hour. The browser keeps it only in a secure cookie.
gate.adminExists: An administrator account exists. Sign in as an administrator to continue setup.

language.title: Language
language.help: Default language for setup and the administrator account. You can change it in the panel at any time.

checks.title: System pre-checks
checks.help: Checks the API can verify from its own container: PostgreSQL, Redis, database migrations and the background worker. Operating system, disk and port checks run on the server with "sh scripts/install.sh check".

access.title: Deployment and access address
access.help: The address users will open the panel at. The test checks whether the server can reach itself through this address. Behind NAT a server may not reach its own public address; then the address is saved as unverified.

domain.title: Domain and HTTPS
domain.help: The name the panel will be opened at over HTTPS from the internet. DNS, HTTP reachability and the certificate are tested separately; one passing does not mean the others pass. You can also run without a domain: skip this step and use 127.0.0.1 or an SSH tunnel.

services.title: PostgreSQL and Redis
services.help: The application's database and queue connections. These services run only on the internal Docker network and are never exposed to the internet.

admin.title: Administrator account
admin.help: The first account that manages the panel. After this step the setup token stops working and setup continues only with this account.

vmware.title: ESXi / vCenter connection
vmware.help: Connection to the VMware infrastructure. If skipped, the platform cannot manage virtual servers.

discovery.title: Datastore and network discovery
discovery.help: Real datastore, network and port group information from the connected infrastructure.

pools.title: Resource pool and IP plan
pools.help: Capacity and IP ranges to offer for sale or use.

monitoring.title: Monitoring and notifications
monitoring.help: Prometheus, Grafana and Loki are optional and run in a separate Compose profile. Notification channels are not available yet.

summary.title: Final check and summary
summary.help: Status of each step. Setup cannot finish until required steps are done. Once finished, setup endpoints close; reopening needs "node dist/cli.js recover-setup" on the server.

notAvailable.vmware: The ESXi/vCenter connection arrives in a later version (phase 6). With this step skipped the platform cannot manage virtual servers yet.
notAvailable.discovery: Discovery arrives together with the ESXi/vCenter connection.
notAvailable.pools: Resource pools and the IP plan arrive in a later version (phase 8).

access.label: Panel address
access.help: Examples: https://panel.example.com or http://127.0.0.1:8080 through an SSH tunnel. Do not add a path, query or user info.

hint.DNS_FAILED: The domain did not resolve. Check that the A record points to the server's public IP and has propagated.
hint.CONNECTION_REFUSED: Connection refused. Check port forwarding, the firewall and the address Caddy listens on (LISTEN_ADDRESS).
hint.TIMEOUT: Timed out. A firewall or NAT may be dropping the connection.
hint.TLS_ERROR: The TLS certificate could not be verified. Do not disable certificate checks; fix the certificate and domain.
hint.WRONG_TARGET: This address answers but is not this installation. DNS or a proxy points to another server.
hint.HTTP_ERROR: The address returned an unexpected HTTP response. A proxy in front may not forward /api to this installation.
hint.LOOPBACK_NOT_VERIFIABLE: 127.0.0.1 and localhost cannot be verified from inside the container. You can save it for use through an SSH tunnel.
hint.UNREACHABLE: The address could not be reached. Check the address and the network path.

domain.label: Domain name
domain.help: Example: panel.example.com. A subdomain is recommended rather than the bare domain.

howto.dnsRecord: At your DNS provider create an A record for this name pointing to the server's public IPv4 address. Add an AAAA record only if the server has working public IPv6. Do not enter a private address (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x); behind NAT enter your router's public address and forward ports 80/443 to this server.
howto.ports: Ports 80 and 443 must reach this server from the internet: Let's Encrypt validates over 80 (HTTP-01) or 443 (TLS-ALPN-01). If another web server uses these ports, use the 'behind-proxy' mode.
howto.apply: Run the command below on the server. Use --acme-staging first while testing so repeated attempts do not hit real certificate rate limits. Once it works, run it again without that option.
howto.test: Then use 'Test connection' to check DNS, HTTP and the certificate separately. Caddy renews the certificate automatically and keeps it in a persistent volume (caddy_data).

domain.behindProxy: To run behind an existing Nginx/Caddy/Traefik use 'sudo sh scripts/install.sh behind-proxy': the panel listens with plain HTTP on 127.0.0.1 and your proxy terminates TLS. Details: docs/domain-https.md
domain.aaaaWarning: This name has an AAAA (IPv6) record. If IPv6 does not really work on the server, remove the record; otherwise some visitors and certificate validation will fail.

hint.DNS_FAILED: The name did not resolve. Create the A record and wait for it to propagate (minutes to hours).
hint.NO_ADDRESS_RECORDS: The name exists but has no A record. Add an A record pointing to the server's public IPv4 address.
hint.CONNECTION_REFUSED: Connection refused: nothing listens on that port. Did you run the installer's 'domain' command? A firewall or port forwarding may block 80/443.
hint.TIMEOUT: Timed out: a firewall or NAT may be dropping the connection. Open 80/443 in your cloud provider's firewall.
hint.HTTP_ERROR: Unexpected HTTP response. A proxy or CDN in front may not forward requests to this installation.
hint.TLS_ERROR: The certificate could not be verified (expired, for another name or self-signed). Do not disable certificate checks; check the domain and Caddy logs: docker compose logs proxy
hint.CERT_STAGING: This is a test certificate. If everything works, run the command again without --acme-staging to get a real certificate.
hint.WRONG_TARGET: This name answers but is not this installation. DNS or a proxy in front points to another server.
hint.UNREACHABLE: The address could not be reached.
